description: Server-side web development with PHP and MySQL: dynamic pages, forms, sessions, a complete CRUD application with validation and injection-proof queries, a user registration system, and deployment to a real host. Taught to the depth of a leading server-side web development course.
modelledOn: Nixon, Learning PHP, MySQL and JavaScript
OWASP Top Ten and OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
outcomes: Set up a PHP and MySQL development environment and structure a database-driven project.
Generate dynamic pages with PHP, control HTTP headers, redirects and sessions.
Process forms safely with validation, sanitisation and CSRF protection.
Build complete create, read, update and delete functionality with prepared statements.
Implement secure user registration, login, password hashing and access control.
Deploy a PHP application to a hosting server, administer it and harden it.

units.title: Server-side web and project setup
topics: Request-response revisited: how a server runs code; Apache or Nginx with PHP-FPM; XAMPP or Docker locally
PHP syntax: variables, types, arrays, strings, control flow, functions, include and require
Project structure: public folder, templates, configuration, Composer and autoloading
MySQL setup: creating a database and user, phpMyAdmin or the CLI, importing a schema
Version control for the project from day one

units.title: Web pages with PHP
topics: Mixing PHP and HTML; templates, layouts and partials; escaping output with htmlspecialchars
Superglobals: $_GET, $_POST, $_SERVER, $_FILES, $_COOKIE, $_SESSION
Dates, formatting, string functions; error reporting and debugging
Building a multi-page site with shared header and navigation

units.title: Headers and redirects
topics: HTTP status codes and headers; header(), content types, caching headers, file downloads
Redirects after POST (PRG pattern); 404 and error pages
Cookies: setting, reading, expiry, flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite)
Sessions: lifecycle, session_start, regeneration, storage; flash messages

units.title: Forms with PHP and data validation
topics: GET versus POST; reading form data; sticky forms and re-displaying errors
Server-side validation: required, length, format (email, Ghana phone numbers), ranges; filter_var
Sanitisation versus validation; never trusting the client; whitelisting
File uploads: size and type checks, safe storage, image handling
CSRF tokens; honeypots and rate limiting for spam

units.title: PHP and MySQL
topics: Connecting with PDO (and mysqli compared); DSNs, error modes, character sets
Running queries, fetching rows, iterating result sets; transactions
Designing the schema for the course project (users, posts, products, orders)
A data access layer: repository functions or classes

units.title: Preventing SQL injection and other attacks
topics: How SQL injection works: demonstrated on a deliberately vulnerable page
Prepared statements and parameter binding; why escaping is not enough
Cross-site scripting and output escaping; content security policy in brief
The OWASP Top Ten applied to a PHP app; security review checklist

units.title: CRUD
topics: List, detail, create, edit and delete pages; routing with a front controller
Pagination, searching, sorting and filtering
Confirmation dialogs and soft deletes; audit fields
Model-view-controller organisation of the project; a glimpse of Laravel

units.title: User registration system
topics: Registration, email verification, login, logout, remember me
Password hashing with password_hash and password_verify; password reset flows
Authorisation: roles (admin, lecturer, student) and protecting pages
Brute-force protection, session fixation and hijacking defences

units.title: Hosting, server administration and security
topics: Choosing a host: shared hosting, VPS, PaaS; domains and DNS; .gh domains
Deploying with FTP/SFTP or Git; environment configuration; file permissions
HTTPS with Let's Encrypt; PHP configuration hardening; disabling dangerous functions; error display off
Backups of code and database; logs; updates; monitoring uptime
Project: a complete database-driven application (e-commerce shop, school portal or booking system) deployed and demonstrated

schedule.title: PHP basics and project structure
schedule.exercise: Draw the path of an HTTP request through a web server, PHP and back to the browser, and label where your code runs.

tasks.title: Write a PHP script that prints the server time and a greeting based on the hour, then change the hour to test all branches
Write PHP functions using arrays, strings and loops to produce a price list with VAT and a sorted summary for 10 products
Organise a project into a public folder, templates, config and a Composer-style autoloader, and check that classes load from the right paths

schedule.title: Database setup and version control
schedule.exercise: Write a README that lets a classmate recreate your database and run the project from a fresh checkout.

tasks.title: Create a database, a user with limited privileges and a products table, import a schema and check that the privileges work as intended
Initialise a repository, make four commits on a branch, merge it and resolve one deliberate conflict in a PHP file
Write an import script that loads a messy product file into a normalised schema and reports rejected rows with the reason for each

schedule.title: Templates, superglobals and a multi-page site
schedule.exercise: List the superglobals you used this week and give one safe use and one unsafe use of each.

tasks.title: Create a layout template with header, footer and content partials, and escape a user-supplied name with htmlspecialchars to show a script tag stays inert
Build a contact page that reads GET and POST values, shows server and cookie information, and tests a missing parameter
Build a four-page site with shared navigation, active link highlighting and a custom error page, and check every link resolves

schedule.title: HTTP, cookies and sessions
schedule.exercise: Explain in a paragraph why a session ID in a cookie needs Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite flags.

tasks.title: Send correct status codes and content type for a JSON response, a download and a not-found page, and inspect the headers
Set and read a cookie with expiry and security flags, show it expires, and display the header values in the browser tools
Build a session-based flash message and post-redirect-get flow for a form, and prove a page refresh does not resubmit the form

schedule.title: Forms and validation
schedule.exercise: Write a list of validation rules for a Ghana phone number, an email and a date of birth, with two valid and two invalid examples each.

tasks.title: Build a registration form that redisplays entered values and shows error messages next to each field when validation fails
Validate email, Ghana phone numbers, ranges and required fields with filter_var and regular expressions, testing 20 inputs
Implement whitelist validation for a sort and filter parameter set, and show that tampered values are rejected rather than sanitised

schedule.title: Uploads and form protection
schedule.exercise: Draft a policy for accepting profile photo uploads, listing size, type, naming, storage and scanning rules.

tasks.title: Write an upload handler that checks size and type, stores files under random names outside the web root, and test it with six files
Add CSRF tokens to a form, show a forged request is rejected, and test with a missing, wrong and valid token
Add a honeypot field and rate limiting to a sign-up form, then simulate 50 bot submissions and report how many were blocked

schedule.title: PDO, schema design and data access
schedule.exercise: Draw an entity relationship diagram for a school portal with users, posts, products and orders, with keys and relationship types.

tasks.title: Connect to a database with PDO using exception mode and fetch the rows of a table into an HTML table
Design and create the schema for a shop with users, products and orders, add foreign keys and load sample data, then query a customer's order history
Build a repository class with find, create, update and delete methods, use transactions for checkout, and test a failure midway to confirm rollback

schedule.title: Security: SQL injection, XSS and OWASP
schedule.exercise: Review a page against a security checklist and write the five most important fixes in order of risk.

tasks.title: Exploit a deliberately vulnerable login query with a crafted input to bypass authentication, and record the SQL that was actually executed
Rewrite the vulnerable queries with prepared statements and parameter binding, and confirm that ten attack strings fail
Find and fix a stored cross-site scripting hole in a comment page with output escaping and a content security policy, then retest with attack payloads

schedule.title: CRUD pages, routing and search
schedule.exercise: Sketch the URL structure and page list for a product management section of a shop and which HTTP method each uses.

tasks.title: Build list, detail, create, edit and delete pages for products behind a front controller that routes five URLs
Add pagination, search, sort and filter to a product list using safe queries, and check page counts for 53 rows with 10 per page
Write an optimised listing query with a combined filter, sort and pagination, and compare its query plan with and without an index

schedule.title: Soft deletes, audit fields and MVC
schedule.exercise: Explain why a school portal might use soft deletes and what risks they bring.

tasks.title: Add soft deletes with a deleted_at column and audit fields to a table, then write queries that hide, list and restore removed rows
Reorganise a small page-script project into models, views and controllers, and show a new page needs changes in only one controller and one view
Compare your hand-made MVC structure with the conventions of a framework, then add a new feature to your project in both styles

schedule.title: Authentication and authorisation
schedule.exercise: Describe a password reset flow step by step and list two ways each step can be attacked.

tasks.title: Hash a password with password_hash, verify it with password_verify, and show two identical passwords give different hashes
Build registration, email verification, login, logout and remember-me for a school portal, and test each with valid and invalid cases
Add role-based access for admin, lecturer and student, brute-force lockout and session regeneration, then run a scripted attack that must fail

schedule.title: Hosting, deployment and HTTPS
schedule.exercise: Compare shared hosting, a VPS and a platform service for a school website in Ghana on cost, control and skills needed.

tasks.title: Choose a hosting plan and domain for a small business in a case, weighing cost, support and local availability, and score the decision
Deploy a PHP project to a server using Git, set environment configuration and file permissions, and fix a permission error that breaks uploads
Enable HTTPS with a certificate, redirect HTTP, harden PHP settings and turn error display off, then verify with checks from the outside

schedule.title: Operations and final project
schedule.exercise: Write the runbook for your project: how to back it up, restore it, read its logs and apply an update safely.

tasks.title: Schedule database and code backups, rotate logs and restore a backup to a new server to prove it works
Seed and test the database for the final project with realistic data of 100 rows per table and check all reports run correctly
Deliver a complete database-driven application, such as a shop, school portal or booking system, with authentication, security tests and a deployed demo
